{"redline": [{"index": 0, "kind": "equal", "text": "Definition of Real Property Taxes. The term “Sales Taxes” means all sales, transaction and/or service taxes, levies, fees and/or other impositions which may, from time to time, be levied or imposed on the Rentals, or any portion thereof, any other item of rent under the Lease, or any item of goods, materials, labor or services to be provided under the Lease.
